# scon_rule (Resource)

The rule records of the service, through its state import and export



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `key` (String) the record key, its identity in the service and in references
- `name` (String)

### Optional

- `aggregate` (String) `avg` on create
- `bookable_id` (String)
- `code` (String) Tengo that sets `firing`
- `comparison` (String) `gt` on create
- `connection_id` (String) A visible connection; required with `metric`
- `device_id` (String) A visible device
- `enabled` (Boolean) `true` on create
- `interval_seconds` (Number) 60 on create
- `kind` (String) A slug from `GET /api/kinds`; required unless `metric` is set, cleared when it is
- `location_id` (String)
- `metric` (String)
- `severity` (String) `warning` on create
- `threshold` (Number)
- `window_seconds` (Number) 600 on create
